description: Complete approved identity verification before account-specific disclosure.
Collect the minimum facts needed to classify the member's request.
Initiate the approved account-security containment path.
Inspect the institution's authoritative transaction-status source.
Determine whether recipient enrollment explains a pending P2P payment.
Start or route an approved payment trace using available transaction identifiers.
Explain a process without asserting institution-specific terms or outcomes.
Retrieve the member's applicable card agreement, offer, APR, fee, and eligibility terms.
Review posted or pending fees and the institution's approved adjustment policy.
Check card activation, controls, limits, fraud blocks, and network status.
Capture an alleged EFT error using the institution's Regulation E workflow.
Open or route a card-transaction dispute through the approved workflow.
Block, replace, or digitally suspend a card through approved controls.
Review deposit type, notice, availability date, and any applicable exception.
Review return reason, adjustment, notice, and next eligible deposit action.
Use the approved access-recovery and device-security workflow.
Review authoritative loan posting, due-date, balance, and servicing records.
Initiate the official payoff-quote process and delivery method.
Apply the institution's field-of-membership and account-opening criteria.
Route to the designated card-servicing team with a complete case summary.
Route to ACH, P2P, bill-pay, ATM, or wire operations as appropriate.
Route to fraud operations with priority appropriate to the risk signal.
Route to lending or loan-servicing operations with collected facts.
Record the member's claim, facts, actions, and required follow-up.
Confirm the approved next action, owner, and policy-sourced expectation.
Close only after the request, ownership, and follow-up are confirmed.
